Subject: Trouble finishing vendor setup — redirected after SSO

Hi Jonas,

We're trying to finish the supplier portal onboarding for Aurora Works (account ARW-998) but keep getting bounced back to the login page after SSO. The flow starts at the Workday invite link, we authenticate via our IdP, but instead of landing on the onboarding form the browser is redirected to /login with a query string like ?claim=expired.

Our security team verified time sync on our side and everything looks OK. We reproduced this on two team members (myself and Nathan) on Chrome and Safari. Nathan captured the redirect chain and a couple of screenshots (attached).

Can you help? We need to get our banking/PO info in so AP can issue the first PO. We're on a tight timeline to close a supply contract next week.

Thanks,
Priya Sharma

Hi Priya — thanks for the detailed repro and screenshots.

Quick context: we've recently rolled a small change to claim TTL handling for a subset of partner invitations (to close a rare race condition). It's possible your invite hit the old short-TTL path while the redirect was already in flight, which would result in the claim being treated as expired by the onboarding service.

Next steps I propose:
- Ben, can you check the logs for ARW-998 and the invite id in the redirect link (if Priya can paste the full redirect URL) and confirm whether the claim was evaluated as expired at the gateway?
- Olga, can you confirm whether we have any rate-limited refreshes for that partner catalog entry?

Priya — can you paste the full URL you see (including the claim parameter) or forward the browser network trace? If needed we can issue a temporary claim bump on our side to let you through while we patch the short-TTL path.

I'll keep this thread for coordination.

Cheers,
Jonas
Senior Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 13:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Trouble finishing vendor setup — redirected after SSO

Jonas / Olga — I pulled the gateway logs for invite id = 5f4d9a (matches the example claim token Priya sent via DM). Observations:

- At 2026-12-01T16:11:22Z the invite was generated (TTL configured to 5 minutes for the legacy path).
- At 2026-12-01T16:16:00Z we received the SSO callback from auroraworks.com and issued a redirect to the onboarding form.
- The onboarding service performed a claim validation at 2026-12-01T16:16:01Z and returned "claim_expired" — the window narrowed to under a second because the gateway logic erroneously re-evaluates TTL after following an internal redirect.

Root cause: a race between the gateway redirect and a second validation call that applies an already-decremented TTL on the legacy path. New path (rolled last week) fixes this but only for invites generated after 2026-12-01T15:00Z; your invite was older and hit the legacy codepath.

Workaround I applied: temporarily increased claim acceptance window for invite id 5f4d9a to +10 minutes. That should allow users who hit the flow to complete onboarding if they retry immediately. I also created a short runbook for support to perform this bump for ARW invites until we backfill/patch the legacy TTL logic. See attached instructions.

Olga — can you coordinate rolling the longer TTL to our partner catalog entries for the next 24 hours? Also creating JW-4521 to track the permanent fix.

- Ben
Principal Site Reliability Engineer

Hi Priya / Nathan — quick update.

Ben raised a legitimate race condition and we pushed a temporary acceptance-window bump for your specific invite id. Action for you: please try the original invite link again but open it in an incognito/private window (to avoid any cached redirects/cookies). If that still fails, paste the exact URL you see and we'll use the bump on a fresh invite.

If you prefer, we've also created a fresh invite which I attached as an onboarding checklist and re-sent from the partner portal (you should receive that message within 10 minutes). That new invite is valid for 30 minutes under the patched path.

Link: https://app.auroraworks.com/vendor/onboarding/claim/12345 (internal tracking only)

Next steps once you can access the form:
- Complete the bank/PO contact fields (we'll route the PO to AP after verification)
- Upload W-9 and ACH authorization (the checklist has field guidance)

Sorry for the friction — this is on us and we're prioritizing the fix. Please reply here when you can confirm success and we'll close JW-4521.

Best,
